name: boim
description: Hosted read-only MCP server for finding Korean businesses (2.7M, all industries), public-procurement vendors (75,000+) and open public bids. No auth for the free tier, which returns up to 5 results per tool plus a link to the full public list; full results need a BOIM API key.
license: MIT (docs and client-config repo only; hosted server is not open source)

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server; no sign-in or API key for the free tier.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Businesses across all industries in Korea (about 2.7M) by province, city/district (optional dong) and industry or name; name, industry and district only.

tools.name: search_vendors
tools.description: Vendor cards built from Public Procurement Service data (all item categories, last 12 months of records) plus information registered by the businesses; filter by item, category group, region, name or certification.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: Full vendor card: records and amounts by item, main buyer agencies and regions, contract types, unit-price range, certifications, sources and update date.

tools.name: find_public_bids
tools.description: Open public bids in all fields from KONEPS, Defense e-Procurement, LH, K-water and Nuri-jangteo, closest deadline first, with source links.

tools.name: find_local_shops
tools.description: Neighborhood sign, advertising, print and copy shops by city, district and dong.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Procurement category groups and item names with vendor counts.
